ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited's Extra-Ordinary General Meeting proposed significant financial maneuvers, including increasing authorized share capital, issuing equity shares and convertible warrants on a preferential basis (to non-promoters and the promoter group), and substantially expanding borrowing, lending, and investment powers. If approved, these resolutions suggest a major capital raising and expansion strategy, but the preferential issues risk dilution for existing shareholders, and the exceptionally low attendance (87 out of 443,202 shareholders) stands out as a red flag regarding shareholder engagement.
